pages.title: Stress-Energy Tensor
pages.text: The tensor describing how energy, momentum and pressure are distributed in spacetime: the source term of Einstein's equations. It is heavy in some directions and light in others, and seems to press against the hand.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Combining Christoffel symbols with a stellar core and a frozen photon, I described how mass-energy filled spacetime. The Chrono Loom gave me the tensor that tells spacetime how to curve.
Made in $(item)Chrono Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Spacetime Singularity, Unified Notes III.
